article.title: No appeal from a decree passed under rule 5.
article.content:
6No appeal from a decree passed under rule 5.

Order 36, Rule 6
No appeal shall lie from a decree passed under rule 5.]

1 Ins. by Act 104 of 1976, s. 83. (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
